SQL:
WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id",
    customers.tier AS "customers.tier"
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.id,
    customers.tier
), _cm_customers__returns__id_count AS (
  SELECT
    returns.customer_id AS "returns.customer_id",
    customers.tier AS "returns.customers.tier",
    COUNT(returns.id) AS "returns.id_count"
  FROM returns AS returns
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON returns.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY
    returns.customer_id,
    customers.tier
), __slayer_stage_c AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.tier" AS "tier",
    _stage_inner."customers.nret" AS "nret"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _base_2."customers.tier",
      COALESCE(_cm_customers__returns__id_count."returns.id_count", 0) AS "customers.nret"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__returns__id_count
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__returns__id_count."returns.customer_id"
      AND _base_2."customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__returns__id_count."returns.customers.tier"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  c.tier AS "c.tier",
  COUNT(*) AS "c.n"
FROM __slayer_stage_c AS c
WHERE
  c.nret = 0
GROUP BY
  c.tier
LIMIT 21
